events.title: Blood & Chaos - Steam Next Fest Broadcast
events.summary: Blood & Chaos is taking part in October Steam Next Fest!Watch a prerecorded gameplay presentation by PlayfulMindGaming, covering the game's mechanics, party creation, exploration and turn-based combat.You can also download and play the demo for free!Special thanks to PlayfulMindGaming for creating the video! Check out his YouTube channel: PlayfulMindGaming

events.title: Demo Now Available in Japanese! / デモ版が日本語に対応！ 🇯🇵
events.summary: Blood & Chaos のデモ版が日本語でプレイできるようになりました！デモ版を素晴らしい日本語に翻訳してくださった Monkey's Den さんに心から感謝します！日本語でのプレイを待ってくださっていた方は、ぜひこの機会に Blood & Chaos を遊んでみてください！感想やフィードバックも大歓迎です :-)The Blood & Chaos demo can now be played in Japanese!A huge thanks to Monkey's Den, who translated the demo into Japanese!If you've been waiting to play Blood & Chaos in Japanese, I hope you'll give it a try! Feedback is always welcome :-)

events.title: A Long Overdue Update from the Developer
events.summary: I owe you this, especially those of you who have shown interest in Blood & Chaos for a long time now. I've been quite bad at keeping you posted on how development is going. So here is one of my resolutions for 2026: write the very first Steam post!The GenesisBlood & Chaos is the game I've been dreaming of making for decades, ever since I was a teenager and finished playing Ultima IV.
